mapper.select: select id from cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log where topic_id=#{topic} and member_id=#{member} and coupon_id=#{coupon} for update
mapper.insert: insert into cms_topic_completion_coupon_receipt (grant_log_id,topic_id,member_id,coupon_id,history_id,granted_at) select l.id,l.topic_id,l.member_id,l.coupon_id,h.id,h.get_time from cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log l join sms_coupon_history h on h.id=#{history} and h.member_id=l.member_id and h.coupon_id=l.coupon_id where l.id=#{log} and l.topic_id=#{topic} and l.member_id=#{member} and l.coupon_id=#{coupon} and h.get_type=0 and h.use_status=0 and h.get_time is not null and coalesce(h.del_flag,0)=0
mapper.sql: select r.grant_log_id,r.topic_id,r.member_id,r.coupon_id,r.history_id,r.granted_at, h.start_time,h.end_time,h.use_status,h.use_time from cms_topic_completion_coupon_receipt r join sms_coupon_history h on h.id=r.history_id and h.member_id=r.member_id and h.coupon_id=r.coupon_id where r.member_id=#{member} and h.member_id=#{member} and coalesce(h.del_flag,0)=0
mapper.select: and r.grant_log_id > #{cursor} order by r.grant_log_id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log l set receipt_contract_version=1 where l.id=#{log} and l.topic_id=#{topic} and l.member_id=#{member} and l.coupon_id=#{coupon} and l.receipt_contract_version is null and exists(select 1 from cms_topic_completion_coupon_receipt r where r.grant_log_id=l.id and r.topic_id=l.topic_id and r.member_id=l.member_id and r.coupon_id=l.coupon_id and r.history_id=#{history})
mapper.select: select l.id as log_id,l.topic_id,l.member_id,l.coupon_id,l.receipt_contract_version, r.grant_log_id as receipt_log_id,r.topic_id as receipt_topic_id,r.member_id as receipt_member_id, r.coupon_id as receipt_coupon_id,r.history_id,r.granted_at from cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log l left join cms_topic_completion_coupon_receipt r on r.grant_log_id=l.id where l.topic_id=#{topic} and l.member_id=#{member} and l.coupon_id=#{coupon} for update
